method: Real frozen grove. Fit analytic rachis curve coefficients from Float32 tube ring centres then Simpson integrate to actual earliest leaflet st; exclude sheaths because anatomical insertion is not explicitly represented.

albedo.limit: Product of means is a diagnostic proxy, not exact correlated UV/vertex/optics integration or measured specimen reflectance; excludes slab reservation, lighting and exposure

limits: Unfoliated model rachis-root arc is not a measured complete petiole from its hidden anatomical insertion
Spacing CV uses midpoint differential speed between actual same-side leaflet starts; not exact path integration per pair
Rank-plane rotation is inferred from existing leaflet axes relative to a transported local frame; no new geometry/shader modes
